proposed_fixes.title: Ensure startup tray registration is retried when Explorer becomes ready
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: Explorer readiness or a missed retry leaves the initial notification icon unregistered; startup timing must be measured first.
plan: Reproduce startup with the icon setting enabled and compare module and Explorer startup ordering.
Determine whether NIM_ADD fails and whether either existing retry path runs.
If a retry is missed, implement a bounded, lifecycle-safe retry and add regression coverage for failed registration and Explorer restart.
verification: Verify a visible tray icon after normal startup and delayed Explorer readiness, and no duplicate icon after Explorer restart.

reproduce.title: Ensure startup tray registration is retried when Explorer becomes ready
reproduce.version_requirement: Reported build and current PowerToys build
prerequisites: Power Display system tray icon setting enabled
setup: Arrange a test startup where PowerToys starts with Windows.
steps: Restart Windows and check the notification overflow and visible tray before opening Power Display manually.
If the icon is missing, open Power Display and check whether it appears.
Repeat on a current build and note Explorer startup ordering.
reproduce.expected_result: The Power Display icon is present after startup without manually opening the module and remains correct after Explorer restarts.
